## Why This Is Asked
Assesses concrete integration of GitOps (ArgoCD) inside Azure DevOps pipelines, ephemeral environments, cost governance, secret management, and observability at scale.

## Key Concepts
- GitOps with ArgoCD in Azure DevOps pipelines
- Ephemeral AKS namespaces per PR
- Secrets from Azure Key Vault per environment
- Feature flags via Azure App Configuration
- Azure Cost Management budgets as gate before deploy
- Post-deployment health checks and synthetic tests
- Automatic teardown on PR close or after grace period
- End-to-end logging in Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
    - main

variables:
  - group: 'shared-infrastructure'
  - name: kubernetesNamespace
    value: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: gitopsRepo
    value: 'https://github.com/contoso/app-config'
  - name: argoApp
    value: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'

stages:
- stage: Provision
  displayName: 'Provision Ephemeral Environment'
  jobs:
  - job: CreateNamespace
    displayName: 'Create AKS Namespace'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create Kubernetes Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl create namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl label namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) environment=ephemeral pr-id=$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)

- stage: CostGate
  displayName: 'Cost Budget Validation'
  dependsOn: Provision
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: CheckBudget
    displayName: 'Validate Cost Budget'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Check Cost Management Budget'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          currentSpend=$(az costmanagement query --scope "/subscriptions/$(subscriptionId)" --type "ActualCost" --timeframe "MonthToDate" --query "[0].Amount" -o tsv)
          budgetLimit=$(az consumption budget list --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --query "[0].amount" -o tsv)
          if (( $(echo "$currentSpend >= $budgetLimit" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "Cost budget exceeded: $currentSpend >= $budgetLimit"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Cost budget check passed: $currentSpend < $budgetLimit"

- stage: Deploy
  displayName: 'Deploy via ArgoCD'
  dependsOn: CostGate
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: ArgoCDDeploy
    displayName: 'Deploy Application'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create ArgoCD Application'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
          apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
          kind: Application
          metadata:
            name: $(argoApp)
            namespace: argocd
          spec:
            project: ephemeral
            source:
              repoURL: $(gitopsRepo)
              targetRevision: HEAD
              path: environments/$(kubernetesNamespace)
              helm:
                values: |
                  namespace: $(kubernetesNamespace)
                  secrets:
                    keyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    secretNames: ["app-db-connection", "app-api-key"]
                  featureFlags:
                    appConfigurationName: $(appConfigurationName)
                    filter: "env=$(kubernetesNamespace)"
            destination:
              server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
              namespace: $(kubernetesNamespace)
            syncPolicy:
              automated:
                prune: true
                selfHeal: true
              syncOptions:
                - CreateNamespace=false
                - PrunePropagationPolicy=foreground
          EOF

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Wait for ArgoCD Sync'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          timeout=600
          interval=10
          elapsed=0
          while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
            status=$(kubectl get application $(argoApp) -n argocd -o jsonpath='{.status.health.status}')
            if [ "$status" = "Healthy" ]; then
              echo "Application deployed successfully"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for deployment... ($elapsed/$timeout seconds)"
            sleep $interval
            elapsed=$((elapsed + interval))
          done
          if [ $elapsed -ge $timeout ]; then
            echo "Deployment timeout reached"
            exit 1
          fi

- stage: Validate
  displayName: 'Post-Deployment Validation'
  dependsOn: Deploy
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: HealthChecks
    displayName: 'Run Health Checks'
    steps:
    - task: Bash@3
      displayName: 'Application Health Check'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |
          echo "Running health checks for $(kubernetesNamespace)..."
          # Add your health check commands here
          # Example: curl -f http://service-url/health

    - job: SyntheticTests
      displayName: 'Run Synthetic Tests'
      dependsOn: HealthChecks
      steps:
      - task: Bash@3
        displayName: 'Execute Synthetic Tests'
        inputs:
          targetType: 'inline'
          script: |
            echo "Running synthetic tests..."
            # Add your synthetic test commands here
            # Example: npm run test:synthetic

- stage: Teardown
  displayName: 'Teardown Environment'
  dependsOn: Validate
  condition: always()
  jobs:
  - job: Cleanup
    displayName: 'Clean Resources'
    timeoutInMinutes: 30
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Remove ArgoCD Application'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete application $(argoApp) -n argocd --ignore-not-found=true

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Remove Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --ignore-not-found=true
          echo "Namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) cleaned up successfully"

- stage: AutoTeardown
  displayName: 'Scheduled Teardown (48 hours)'
  condition: and(always(), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main'))
  jobs:
  - job: DelayedCleanup
    displayName: 'Wait and Cleanup'
    timeoutInMinutes: 2880  # 48 hours
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Timeout Cleanup'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          echo "48-hour timeout reached, cleaning up environment"
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --ignore-not-found=true
          kubectl delete application $(argoApp) -n argocd --ignore-not-found=true
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question validates the ability to combine per-tenant isolation, cost governance, and centralized telemetry management within a single automated pipeline with built-in rollback capabilities.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant resource scoping with dedicated resource groups, App Configuration, and Key Vault
- Tenant-specific App Service slots with isolated configuration
- Real-time cost forecasting and governance via Azure Cost Management
- Telemetry segregation using tenant-scoped Log Analytics workspaces
- Drift detection and automated rollback strategies

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure DevOps YAML Pipeline for Multi-Tenant Onboarding
trigger: none
pr: none

parameters:
  - name: tenantId
    type: string
  - name: tenantName
    type: string
  - name: costThresholdUSD
    type: number
    default: 500

stages:
  - stage: PreValidation
    jobs:
      - job: CostForecastGate
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: CheckCostForecast
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                # Query Cost Management for 30-day forecast
                COST=$(az cost management query \
                  --scope /subscriptions/$SUBSCRIPTION_ID \
                  --query "properties[0].columns[?(@.name=='Cost')].rows[0]" \
                  --timeframe ThisMonth \
                  --dataset-name CurrentMonth \
                  -o tsv)
                
                PROJECTED=$(( COST * 30 / $(date +%d) ))
                
                if [ $PROJECTED -gt ${{ parameters.costThresholdUSD }} ]; then
                  echo "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Projected cost \$$PROJECTED exceeds threshold \$${{ parameters.costThresholdUSD }}"
                  exit 1
                fi

  - stage: ProvisionResources
    dependsOn: PreValidation
    jobs:
      - job: CreateTenantResources
        steps:
          - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
            name: ProvisionRG
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              resourceGroupName: 'rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }}'
              location: 'East US'
              templateLocation: 'Inline'
              mode: 'Incremental'

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: ProvisionAppConfig
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az appconfig create \
                  --name "appconfig-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --resource-group "rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --location "East US"

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: ProvisionKeyVault
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az keyvault create \
                  --name "kv-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --resource-group "rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --location "East US"

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: CreateLogAnalytics
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor log-analytics workspace create \
                  --workspace-name "la-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --resource-group "rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --location "East US"

  - stage: DeployAppService
    dependsOn: ProvisionResources
    jobs:
      - job: DeploySlot
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppServiceSettings@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              appName: 'saas-api-${{ parameters.tenantName }}'
              slotName: 'staging'
              appSettings: |
                TENANT_ID=${{ parameters.tenantId }}
                APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT=https://appconfig-${{ parameters.tenantName }}.azconfig.io
                KEY_VAULT_URI=https://kv-${{ parameters.tenantName }}.vault.azure.net/
                LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID=$(az monitor log-analytics workspace show --workspace-name la-${{ parameters.tenantName }} --resource-group rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }} --query customerId -o tsv)

          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              WebAppName: 'saas-api-${{ parameters.tenantName }}'
              SourceSlot: 'staging'

  - stage: ValidateAndMonitor
    dependsOn: DeployAppService
    jobs:
      - job: HealthCheck
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: VerifyTenantAccess
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                # Verify Key Vault access policy and App Configuration keys
                az keyvault secret list --vault-name "kv-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" | jq 'length'
                az appconfig kv list --name "appconfig-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" | jq 'length'

          - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
            inputs:
              targetPath: '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)'
              artifact: 'tenant-config-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'
```

## Why This Question Matters
This tests your ability to build ephemeral environments for PR reviews - a key DevOps skill. You need to show you understand AKS namespaces, Helm deployments, secret management, and cost control through automated cleanup.

## Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Azure DevOps Pipeline                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  1. Trigger: PR created/updated                                 │
│  2. Create Namespace (pr-{PR_ID})                               │
│  3. Deploy Helm charts to namespace                             │
│  4. Inject Key Vault secrets                                    │
│  5. Run integration tests                                      │
│  6. Update PR with environment URL                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Complete Pipeline YAML

```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - '*'

variables:
  aksClusterName: 'ephemeral-aks-cluster'
  resourceGroup: 'rg-ephemeral-environments'
  helmVersion: '3.14.0'
  prNamespace: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)'
  keyVaultName: 'kv-ephemeral-secrets'

stages:
  - stage: Setup
    displayName: 'Create PR Environment'
    jobs:
      - job: CreateNamespace
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Connect to AKS'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --overwrite-existing

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create PR Namespace with Quotas'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                kubectl create namespace $(prNamespace) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
                cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
                apiVersion: v1
                kind: ResourceQuota
                metadata:
                  name: pr-quota
                  namespace: $(prNamespace)
                spec:
                  hard:
                    requests.cpu: '4'
                    requests.memory: 8Gi
                    pods: '20'
                ---
                apiVersion: v1
                kind: LimitRange
                metadata:
                  name: pr-limits
                  namespace: $(prNamespace)
                spec:
                  limits:
                    - default:
                        cpu: '1'
                        memory: 2Gi
                      defaultRequest:
                        cpu: '100m'
                        memory: 256Mi
                      type: Container
                EOF

          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Fetch PR Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy to PR Environment'
    dependsOn: Setup
    jobs:
      - job: HelmDeploy
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Configure kubectl'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup)

          - task: HelmInstaller@1
            displayName: 'Install Helm'
            inputs:
              helmVersionToInstall: $(helmVersion)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Deploy Helm Release'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                helm upgrade --install pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) ./charts/microservices 
                  --namespace $(prNamespace) --create-namespace 
                  --set image.tag=$(Build.BuildId) 
                  --set environment=pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) 
                  --wait --timeout 5m

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create CSI SecretProviderClass'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
```

```yaml
trigger: none
schedules:
  - cron: '0 0 * * *'
    branches:
      include:
        - main

variables:
  aksClusterName: 'ephemeral-aks-cluster'
  resourceGroup: 'rg-ephemeral-environments'
  ttlHours: 48

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

steps:
  - task: AzureCLI@2
    displayName: 'Delete Expired PR Namespaces'
    inputs:
      azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
      scriptType: 'bash'
      scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
      inlineScript: |
        az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --overwrite-existing
        for NS in $(kubectl get ns -o jsonpath='{range .items[?(@.metadata.name=~"^pr-")]} {.metadata.name} {end}'); do
          AGE_HOURS=$(($(date +%s) - $(date -d $(kubectl get ns $NS -o jsonpath='{.metadata.creationTimestamp}') +%s)) / 3600)
          if [ $AGE_HOURS -gt $(ttlHours) ]; then
            helm uninstall -n $NS || true
            kubectl delete ns $NS --wait=true
          fi
        done
```
